Websites & digital products

Strategy, interface design and development for sites, stores and digital products.

Brand & visual identity

Identity systems and graphic design made to work across your website, social channels and day-to-day materials.

We find the qualities that make the business distinct, then translate them into a flexible identity: typography, colour, image direction and reusable graphic elements. The system is designed to stay recognisable across the website, social channels, presentations and printed materials.

PR, digital marketing and social media direction built around your audience and goals.

From brief to launch

A clear process,
with room to think.

Projects can start with a defined brief or an open question. We agree on the scope together, keep decisions visible and make progress in useful stages.

01

Listen & frame

We learn about the people you need to reach, how the business works today and what a successful outcome should change. That gives the project a clear measure of progress.

02

Choose a direction

We compare priorities, content, visual references and technical constraints, then agree on a direction before detailed design begins.

03

Make & test

You see a working version early. We review it together, test it on the devices that matter and refine the details from real feedback.

04

Launch & care

We prepare the launch, hand over the files and access, then agree what support or updates will keep the work useful over time.

QF / 01
FROM IDEA TO IMPACTMake it
matter.
A practical way to begin

One project can start with one clear need.

You do not need to know every deliverable before getting in touch. We can begin with the challenge in front of you, agree what would make a useful difference and shape the work around that.

01 / FOCUS

A focused start

Bring one page, one identity question or one campaign that needs attention. We’ll define the goal, the people it needs to serve and a realistic first scope before making anything.

02 / CONNECT

A connected launch

When a new offer needs both a clear brand and a digital home, the pieces can be planned together. That keeps the message, visual language and customer journey working as one experience.

03 / CONTINUE

Room to evolve

If the first launch is only the beginning, we can identify what should be maintained, measured or improved next. The plan can grow as the business learns what its audience needs.

Need more than one service?

Tell us what you’re building and what feels unresolved. We’ll help you find a useful starting point and decide which parts of the work belong together.

QAFAROVS®

QAFAROVS® is a creative studio proudly built around the Gafarov family name, with the long-term vision of growing into a global digital studio. We partner with founders, small teams, and growing businesses to turn their initial ideas and aspirations into meaningful digital experiences.

Our work spans strategy, brand identity, websites, and digital products, along with marketing and ongoing development when a project calls for it. Every collaboration begins with a close look at the audience, context, and constraints. From there, we outline a practical scope and set a clear path forward.

Based in Azerbaijan - works with teams around the world. We value open communication, attention to detail, and decisions that align with each project’s goals.
